source_doc.title: Fabrinet Q4 FY2026 earnings call (2026-08-24) — CPO/NPO commentary (third-party transcript)
source_doc.permission_basis: Limited research-relevant quotes from a publicly available third-party transcript; tier-1 upgrade path is the issuer webcast replay.

sources.locator: CEO Seamus Grady, Q&A on CPO
sources.quote: We are working on CPO today with a handful of customers, and we are already building devices all albeit not yet at full scale volumes.

sources.locator: CEO Seamus Grady, Q&A on NPO vs CPO
sources.quote: NPO represents a more near term opportunity than CPO from what we have seen with our customers.

claims.statement: Fabrinet CEO states the company is working on CPO with a handful of customers and is already building CPO devices, though not yet at full-scale volumes (as of the Q4 FY2026 call, 2026-08-24); customers are not named.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if subsequent calls walk back CPO build activity, or if no CPO volume ramp is disclosed within two fiscal years.

claims.statement: Fabrinet CEO characterizes NPO (near-packaged optics) as a nearer-term opportunity than CPO based on what the company sees from its customers.
claims.disproof_condition: Reassess if CPO volume orders arrive before NPO at Fabrinet, or if the company reverses this characterization in later calls.
